words.enDefinition: the ability to produce a good at a lower opportunity cost than another producer or economy

examples.en: The class identified comparative advantage by calculating how much bread each economy gave up for extra cloth.
examples.zh: 同学们计算各经济体为多生产布料需要放弃多少面包，由此识别「比较优势」。

examples.en: An economy could have comparative advantage in cloth even when it produced both goods more slowly overall.
examples.zh: 即使某经济体生产两种商品的速度都较慢，它也可能在布料上具有「比较优势」。

words.enDefinition: the ability to produce a good with fewer resources per unit, or more output from the same resources, than another producer

examples.en: The workshop had an absolute advantage in chairs because it needed fewer labour hours for each one.
examples.zh: 车间制作每把椅子所需工时更少，因此在椅子生产上具有「绝对优势」。

examples.en: We compared absolute advantage across two goods before finding what each producer sacrificed to make them.
examples.zh: 我们先比较两种商品的「绝对优势」，再计算各生产者生产它们要放弃什么。

collocations: distinguish absolute advantage from comparative advantage

words.enDefinition: the increased consumption possibilities or economic surplus made possible by exchanging goods or services

examples.en: The diagram showed gains from trade when each community could obtain more of the goods it valued.
examples.zh: 当各社区能取得更多自己看重的商品时，图中显示了「贸易利得」。

examples.en: We compared aggregate gains from trade with the losses experienced by particular producers in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，我们比较整体「贸易利得」与特定生产者遭受的损失。

words.enDefinition: a benchmark in which an economy does not trade with other economies

examples.en: The example began in autarky, so each economy consumed only what it produced within its own borders.
examples.zh: 示例从「自给自足状态」开始，各经济体只消费境内生产的商品。

examples.en: The tutor compared the feasible consumption bundles in autarky with those available after trade began.
examples.zh: 导师将「自给自足状态」下可行的消费组合与开始贸易后可获得的组合作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the domestic equilibrium price of a good when the economy does not trade it externally in the model

examples.en: We compared the autarky price with the world price to predict whether the example economy would export.
examples.zh: 我们将「自给自足价格」与世界价格比较，预测示例经济体是否会出口。

examples.en: The tutor marked the autarky price where domestic supply met domestic demand before any trade occurred.
examples.zh: 导师将贸易发生前国内供给等于国内需求的价格标为「自给自足价格」。

collocations: compare the autarky price with the world price
mark the autarky price in a diagram

words.enDefinition: the price of a good on the external market relevant to a trade model or comparison

examples.en: In our small-economy example, the world price stayed fixed when local consumer demand increased.
examples.zh: 在小型经济体的示例里，当地消费需求上涨时，「世界价格」保持不变。

examples.en: We measured the gap between the domestic market price and the world price for the imported good.
examples.zh: 我们衡量了该进口商品的国内市场价格与「世界价格」之差。

collocations: take the world price as given
compare domestic prices with the world price
respond to a change in the world price

words.enDefinition: the domestic price of one good expressed in units of another good or as a price ratio

examples.en: The domestic relative price of rice rose when rice became more expensive but wheat prices stayed unchanged.
examples.zh: 小麦价格不变而大米涨价时，大米的「国内相对价格」上升了。

examples.en: We found the domestic relative price from the slope of the budget line before comparing consumption bundles.
examples.zh: 我们根据预算线斜率求出「国内相对价格」，再比较消费组合。

collocations: compare domestic relative prices across economies
measure a change in the domestic relative price

words.enDefinition: the price of one good in international exchange relative to the price of another good

examples.en: The international relative price lay between the two economies' initial price ratios in our simple trade example.
examples.zh: 简单贸易示例中的「国际相对价格」介于两个经济体原有的价格比之间。

examples.en: The tutor changed the international relative price to show how the gains were shared between the economies.
examples.zh: 导师改变「国际相对价格」，演示收益如何在两个经济体之间分配。

collocations: compare the international relative price with domestic ratios
take the international relative price as given

words.enDefinition: an economy exporting more than it imports in a specified good, sector or total trade measure

examples.en: The example economy became a net exporter of fruit even though it still imported some varieties.
examples.zh: 示例经济体成为水果的「净出口方」，尽管它仍进口某些品种。

examples.en: We checked trade records to see whether the region was a net exporter of machinery.
examples.zh: 我们用进出口记录判断该地区是否为机械产品的「净出口方」。

collocations: compare a net exporter with a net importer

words.enDefinition: an economy importing more than it exports in a specified good, sector or total trade measure

examples.en: The country remained a net importer of fuel despite selling a small amount to a neighbouring market.
examples.zh: 这个国家向邻近市场出售少量燃料，但仍是燃料的「净进口方」。

examples.en: Our chart changed when the example region went from being a net importer to exporting more grain.
examples.zh: 示例地区从粮食「净进口方」变为出口多于进口时，我们的图也随之改变。

words.enDefinition: concentrating production in a narrower range of activities as an economy exchanges goods with trade partners

examples.en: In the model, trade specialisation shifted workers toward the industry with the lower relative production cost.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「贸易分工」使劳动者转向相对生产成本较低的行业。

examples.en: We compared trade specialisation across two examples with very different opportunities to exchange goods abroad.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个示例中的「贸易分工」，两者从国外交换商品的机会很不相同。

words.enDefinition: allocating all relevant production resources to one good in a model with alternative goods

examples.en: The simple model predicted complete specialisation when the world price made producing the second good unprofitable.
examples.zh: 世界价格使生产第二种商品无法盈利时，简单模型预测将出现「完全专业化分工」。

examples.en: We tested whether complete specialisation still followed once workers could not easily move between the two industries.
examples.zh: 当劳动者无法轻易跨行业流动时，我们检验是否仍会形成「完全专业化分工」。

collocations: compare complete specialisation with diversified production

words.enDefinition: a trade outcome in which an economy shifts resources toward selected activities but still produces multiple goods

examples.en: Our example showed incomplete specialisation because both goods remained profitable at the country's new relative price.
examples.zh: 在该国新的相对价格下，两种商品仍有利可图，所以示例出现了「不完全专业化分工」。

examples.en: We used a curved production frontier to show when incomplete specialisation could persist after trade opened.
examples.zh: 我们用弯曲的生产可能性边界说明，开放贸易后何时仍会存在「不完全专业化分工」。

words.enDefinition: an economy open to international transactions and treated as too small to affect relevant world prices in the model

examples.en: The lesson treated the region as a small open economy that took the outside price as given.
examples.zh: 课堂把该地区视为接受外部市场价格的「小型开放经济体」。

examples.en: We assumed a small open economy before analysing how an import tax would affect local purchases.
examples.zh: 分析进口税怎样影响当地购买量前，我们采用了「小型开放经济体」假设。

collocations: assume the country is a small open economy

words.enDefinition: an economy whose trade decisions are substantial enough to affect world prices or global markets in the model

examples.en: The large open economy could influence the world price because it accounted for much of global demand.
examples.zh: 这个「大型开放经济体」占全球需求的很大一部分，因此能影响世界价格。

examples.en: We compared a large open economy with an importer that purchased too little to change world prices.
examples.zh: 我们把「大型开放经济体」与购买量小到无法改变世界价格的进口方作了比较。

collocations: analyse policy in a large open economy
compare a large open economy with a small one

words.enDefinition: a balance of supply and demand when trade is permitted without the trade barriers being analysed

examples.en: In free-trade equilibrium, the quantity traded matched the gap between domestic demand and domestic output in our diagram.
examples.zh: 在我们的图里，「自由贸易均衡」时的贸易量等于国内需求与国内产量之间的差额。

examples.en: The tutor used free-trade equilibrium as the benchmark before introducing a tariff in the model.
examples.zh: 导师以「自由贸易均衡」为基准，再向假想模型加入关税。

collocations: compare a tariff outcome with free-trade equilibrium

words.zhGloss: 贸易额与 GDP 之比
words.enDefinition: the sum of exports and imports expressed as a percentage or fraction of gross domestic product
acceptedZhAnswers: 贸易额与 GDP 之比

examples.en: We calculated the trade-to-GDP ratio by adding exports and imports before dividing by the published output figure.
examples.zh: 我们先加总出口和进口，再除以公布的产出数字，求得「贸易额与 GDP 之比」。

examples.en: The tutor explained why a trade-to-GDP ratio above one could occur in a highly connected small economy.
examples.zh: 导师说明，为什么联系紧密的小型经济体的「贸易额与 GDP 之比」可能大于一。

words.enDefinition: the share of domestic use or consumption of a product supplied by imports, under the stated measurement convention

examples.en: We calculated import penetration using domestic consumption rather than total output as the denominator in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们用国内消费量作分母来计算「进口渗透率」。

examples.en: The industry report showed import penetration rising while the total amount purchased by local firms also grew.
examples.zh: 行业报告显示，当地厂商购买总量增长的同时，「进口渗透率」也在上升。

collocations: explain a rise in import penetration

words.enDefinition: a graph of the quantity demanded from abroad at alternative prices, often derived from domestic demand minus domestic supply

examples.en: The import demand curve reached zero at the price where domestic supply met domestic demand.
examples.zh: 在国内供给等于国内需求的价格处，「进口需求曲线」的进口量为零。

examples.en: We drew the import demand curve from the differences between domestic consumption and production at each price.
examples.zh: 我们用各价格下国内消费与生产的差额，绘出「进口需求曲线」。

collocations: read a quantity from the import demand curve

words.enDefinition: a graph of the amount offered abroad at different prices, often domestic supply minus domestic demand

examples.en: The export supply curve showed larger quantities offered abroad at higher prices in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，「出口供给曲线」显示世界价格较高时，可供应国外的商品更多。

examples.en: We formed the export supply curve by subtracting domestic purchases from what local firms produced at each price.
examples.zh: 我们在各个价格下用本地厂商总产量减去国内购买量，得到「出口供给曲线」。

collocations: match export supply with import demand

words.enDefinition: an increase in export prices relative to import prices, allowing a given volume of exports to purchase more imports

examples.en: Rising export prices and unchanged import prices produced a terms-of-trade improvement in the simplified example.
examples.zh: 在简化示例中，出口价格上涨且进口价格不变，带来了「贸易条件改善」。

examples.en: The report separated the terms-of-trade improvement from the change in the physical volume of goods sold.
examples.zh: 报告把「贸易条件改善」与商品实际销售量的变化区分开来。

words.enDefinition: a substantial change in the ratio of export prices to import prices caused by a new development

examples.en: A sharp drop in the price of its main export created a terms-of-trade shock in the model.
examples.zh: 主要出口品价格骤跌，在模型中造成了「贸易条件冲击」。

examples.en: We compared the effects of a terms-of-trade shock on two small economies with different export baskets.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「贸易条件冲击」对两个出口商品构成不同的小型经济体的影响。

collocations: estimate the effects of a terms-of-trade shock

words.enDefinition: a trade model explaining specialisation through differences in relative production productivity, commonly with labour as the only input

examples.en: The Ricardian trade model used different labour requirements for making the same goods in the two economies.
examples.zh: 「李嘉图贸易模型」为两经济体生产同类商品设置了不同的劳动需求量。

examples.en: We used the Ricardian trade model to see why absolute productivity did not determine export patterns by itself.
examples.zh: 我们用「李嘉图贸易模型」说明为何仅凭绝对生产率无法决定出口格局。

collocations: derive trade patterns in a Ricardian trade model

words.enDefinition: the amount of labour required to produce one unit of output, typically measured in work hours

examples.en: The unit labour requirement was higher for cloth than for grain in the first classroom economy.
examples.zh: 课堂里的第一个经济体生产布料的「单位产品劳动需求」高于谷物。

examples.en: We lowered the unit labour requirement in the exercise to represent an improvement in production technology.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们调低「单位产品劳动需求」，表示生产技术进步。

words.enDefinition: the productive resources available to an economy, such as its labour, land or capital

examples.en: The trade model gave each region a different factor endowment while assuming they used identical production methods.
examples.zh: 贸易模型给各地区设定不同「要素禀赋」，同时假定生产方法相同。

examples.en: We compared the factor endowment of a labour-rich region with that of a region rich in capital.
examples.zh: 我们比较劳动力丰富地区与资本丰富地区的「要素禀赋」。

words.enDefinition: relative availability of a production factor in one economy compared with another under the chosen measure

examples.en: We compared factor abundance using the ratio of capital to labour, because the countries differed in size.
examples.zh: 由于国家规模不同，我们用资本与劳动的比率比较「要素丰裕性」。

examples.en: The instructor used factor abundance to explain the trade pattern expected in the simplified two-country model.
examples.zh: 讲师借助「要素丰裕性」解释简化的两国模型所预期的贸易格局。

collocations: relate factor abundance to export specialisation

words.enDefinition: a model linking trade patterns to differences in economies' relative factor endowments and goods' relative factor intensities

examples.en: The Heckscher-Ohlin model predicted that the capital-rich economy would export the goods produced with relatively more capital.
examples.zh: 「赫克歇尔俄林模型」预测资本丰富的经济体会出口相对耗用更多资本的商品。

examples.en: We identified both input ratios before applying the Heckscher-Ohlin model to the example economies.
examples.zh: 将「赫克歇尔俄林模型」用于示例经济体之前，我们先确定两种要素比率。

collocations: derive a result in the Heckscher-Ohlin model
test assumptions of the Heckscher-Ohlin model

words.zhGloss: 斯托尔珀萨缪尔森定理
words.enDefinition: under a standard two-good two-factor model, a rise in a good's relative price raises the real return to its relatively intensive factor and lowers the other factor's return
acceptedZhAnswers: 斯托尔珀萨缪尔森定理

examples.en: The Stolper-Samuelson theorem linked a higher cloth price to changes in both real factor returns in our example.
examples.zh: 「斯托尔珀萨缪尔森定理」把示例中更高的布料价格与两种要素实际回报的变化联系起来。

examples.en: We checked the model assumptions before using the Stolper-Samuelson theorem to interpret a changed relative price.
examples.zh: 用「斯托尔珀萨缪尔森定理」解释相对价格变化前，我们核对了模型假设。

words.enDefinition: a trade model with some production factors tied to particular industries while others can move between industries

examples.en: The specific-factors model kept machinery in its original industry while allowing labour to move between sectors.
examples.zh: 「特定要素模型」把机器留在原行业，同时允许劳动者在部门之间流动。

examples.en: The tutor used the specific-factors model to discuss the short-run distribution of gains after export prices rose.
examples.zh: 出口价格上涨后，导师用「特定要素模型」讨论短期收益如何分配。

collocations: analyse factor returns in the specific-factors model

words.enDefinition: a model relating trade between economies to their economic sizes and to costs or barriers such as distance

examples.en: The gravity model of trade predicted more exchange between large neighbouring economies than between similar distant economies.
examples.zh: 「贸易引力模型」预测，相邻的大型经济体之间的贸易多于类似但相距较远的经济体。

examples.en: We estimated a gravity model of trade after adding variables for distance and shared borders.
examples.zh: 我们先加入距离和接壤边界变量，再估计一个「贸易引力模型」。

collocations: estimate a gravity model of trade
apply the gravity model of trade
interpret coefficients in a gravity model of trade

words.enDefinition: a change in the value or volume of transactions within trade links that already exist

examples.en: Growth at the intensive margin of trade came from selling more of the same product to existing buyers.
examples.zh: 「贸易的集约边际」增长来自向现有买家销售更多同类产品。

examples.en: We measured the intensive margin of trade by tracking export volumes for established product and destination pairs.
examples.zh: 我们跟踪已有产品和目的地组合的出口数量，以衡量「贸易的集约边际」。

collocations: measure the intensive margin of trade
grow at the intensive margin of trade
compare the intensive margin of trade across markets

words.enDefinition: the creation or loss of trade links involving new products, trading firms or partner markets

examples.en: New destinations contributed to the extensive margin of trade even though sales to existing importers did not change.
examples.zh: 虽然销往现有进口商的销量没变，但新增目的地推动了「贸易的拓展边际」。

examples.en: The report tracked the extensive margin of trade by counting previously unserved destinations for each product.
examples.zh: 报告按产品统计先前未覆盖的目的地，以跟踪「贸易的拓展边际」。

collocations: measure the extensive margin of trade
increase exports at the extensive margin of trade
distinguish the extensive margin of trade from sales growth

words.enDefinition: exchanges where an economy both imports and exports goods in the same industry category

examples.en: The example showed intra-industry trade because both countries traded different models of bicycles with each other.
examples.zh: 两国彼此交易不同型号的自行车，示例体现了「产业内贸易」。

examples.en: We measured intra-industry trade after making sure both sets of bicycle exports used the same industry category.
examples.zh: 确认两组自行车出口使用同一行业分类之后，我们衡量了「产业内贸易」。

collocations: explain the growth of intra-industry trade

words.enDefinition: a sequence of production tasks spread across economies that each add value to a final good or service

examples.en: The map traced the global value chain from fabric production to assembly and distribution in several countries.
examples.zh: 地图追踪了从布料生产、组装到多国配送的「全球价值链」。

examples.en: We discussed how disruption at one stage of a global value chain could affect deliveries elsewhere.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「全球价值链」一个环节的中断如何可能影响其他地方的交付。

collocations: participate in a global value chain
analyse shocks in a global value chain

words.enDefinition: the portion of exports' value created in the exporting economy through its own production activities

examples.en: The report calculated domestic value added in exports by subtracting the foreign value embedded in those exports.
examples.zh: 报告从出口价值扣除其中包含的国外增加值，计算「出口中的国内增加值」。

examples.en: We compared domestic value added in exports across industries that relied on very different shares of imported inputs.
examples.zh: 我们比较不同产业的「出口中的国内增加值」，这些产业对进口要素的依赖程度很不同。

collocations: estimate domestic value added in exports
report domestic value added in exports
compare domestic value added in exports across industries

words.enDefinition: the portion of exports' value attributable to production activities in other economies

examples.en: The foreign value added in exports included the value created by overseas suppliers making the electronic components.
examples.zh: 「出口中的国外增加值」包括海外供应商制造电子元件的过程中创造的价值。

examples.en: We estimated foreign value added in exports when the assembly sector used the same imported components repeatedly.
examples.zh: 当装配部门持续使用同一类进口元件时，我们估计了「出口中的国外增加值」。

collocations: estimate foreign value added in exports
calculate the share of foreign value added in exports
identify foreign value added in exports

words.enDefinition: broadening the set of products or destinations that contribute to an economy's exports

examples.en: The development report measured export diversification by comparing the number and relative size of different export categories.
examples.zh: 发展报告通过对比各类出口的数量及相对规模，衡量「出口多元化」。

examples.en: We discussed whether entering two new markets would improve export diversification without introducing a new product.
examples.zh: 我们讨论在不推出新产品的情况下，进入两个新市场是否能促进「出口多元化」。

words.enDefinition: the extent to which an economy's export value is dominated by a small number of products or destinations

examples.en: The export concentration measure increased after the main destination bought a much larger share of the country's exports.
examples.zh: 主要目的地购买了该国更大份额的出口品后，「出口集中度」指标上升了。

examples.en: We compared export concentration by product with the concentration of exports across several partner markets.
examples.zh: 我们比较按产品计算的「出口集中度」与按多个贸易伙伴市场计算的集中程度。

words.enDefinition: costs borne as workers, firms or regions adapt to a change in trade patterns or competition

examples.en: The study counted retraining and relocation among trade adjustment costs for workers leaving the affected industry.
examples.zh: 研究把再培训和搬迁计入离开受影响行业劳动者的「贸易调整成本」。

examples.en: Our model included temporary trade adjustment costs before comparing the longer-term gains predicted from lower tariffs.
examples.zh: 对比降低关税所预测的长期收益前，我们的模型计入了暂时的「贸易调整成本」。

collocations: distinguish trade adjustment costs from permanent losses

words.enDefinition: reducing barriers that restrict international trade in goods or services

examples.en: The example described trade liberalisation after duties on several imported components were lowered in the model.
examples.zh: 在模型的若干进口元件关税下调后，示例说明了「贸易自由化」。

examples.en: We compared the projected impact of trade liberalisation across industries using imported inputs in different proportions.
examples.zh: 我们比较「贸易自由化」对各产业的预测影响，这些产业使用进口要素的比例不同。

collocations: analyse the effects of trade liberalisation
study a period of trade liberalisation

words.enDefinition: a tariff computed as a percentage of the relevant value of the imported goods

examples.en: The worksheet calculated the ad valorem tariff from the reported customs value in the fictional shipment.
examples.zh: 练习表用虚构货物申报的海关计税价值计算「从价关税」。

examples.en: We compared an ad valorem tariff with a fixed amount charged for each kilogram in the example.
examples.zh: 我们把「从价关税」与示例中按公斤收取固定金额的关税作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a tariff ceiling committed for a product by a WTO member in its schedule of commitments

examples.en: The table showed the bound tariff above the rate actually charged on the selected imported product.
examples.zh: 表格显示，该进口品的「约束关税税率」高于实际收取的税率。

examples.en: Our class read the bound tariff from the commitment schedule before inspecting the reported applied rate.
examples.zh: 同学们先在承诺表里找到「约束关税税率」，再核查报告的实际执行税率。

collocations: compare a bound tariff with an applied tariff
report the bound tariff for a product

words.enDefinition: the tariff rate currently levied on specified imports under the relevant tariff treatment

examples.en: The applied tariff fell while the tariff ceiling in the commitment schedule remained unchanged in our example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「实际执行关税」下降了，承诺表上的关税上限保持原样。

examples.en: We checked which applied tariff the data recorded for the product and trade partner in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对练习数据对该产品及贸易伙伴记录的是哪种「实际执行关税」。

collocations: check the applied tariff for a product

words.enDefinition: the tariff applicable under most-favoured-nation treatment, apart from rates under permitted preferential arrangements

examples.en: The report listed the most-favoured-nation tariff beside the lower rate applied under a bilateral trade agreement.
examples.zh: 报告将「最惠国关税」与双边贸易协定下适用的较低税率并排列出。

examples.en: We compared the most-favoured-nation tariff across categories of manufactured goods in the published example table.
examples.zh: 我们用公开示例表比较各类制成品的「最惠国关税」。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement in which participating economies share a currency and normally a common monetary policy

examples.en: The two member economies in the example used the same currency after they joined the monetary union.
examples.zh: 示例中的两个成员经济体加入「货币联盟」后，使用同一货币。

examples.en: We discussed how a monetary union affects exchange between its members and transactions with countries outside it.
examples.zh: 我们讨论「货币联盟」怎样影响成员间交易以及与联盟外国家的交易。

collocations: study monetary policy within a monetary union

words.enDefinition: transactions in currency markets by monetary authorities aimed at influencing the exchange rate or exchange market conditions

examples.en: The report listed foreign exchange intervention separately from commercial currency purchases by large private companies that month.
examples.zh: 报告把「外汇干预」与当月大型私企的商业购汇分开列出。

examples.en: Our tutor explained the purpose of foreign exchange intervention in a historical example with a stated exchange target.
examples.zh: 导师解释了一个有明确汇率目标的历史例子里「外汇干预」的目的。

collocations: explain the objective of foreign exchange intervention

words.enDefinition: the currency to which another currency is linked under a chosen exchange rate arrangement

examples.en: The report named the anchor currency before describing how the authorities measured the pegged exchange rate.
examples.zh: 报告先列明「锚定货币」，再说明主管机构怎样衡量被盯住的汇率。

examples.en: We replaced the single anchor currency with a basket to compare the two arrangements in the model.
examples.zh: 我们用一篮子货币替换单一「锚定货币」，以比较模型中的两种安排。

collocations: maintain a link to an anchor currency

words.enDefinition: an exchange arrangement classified from observed policy and exchange rate behaviour rather than only from official announcements

examples.en: The de facto exchange rate regime was classified using how the currency actually moved in the example report.
examples.zh: 示例报告根据货币实际变动情况，对「实际汇率制度」进行了分类。

examples.en: We compared the de facto exchange rate regime with the arrangement officially described in the annual summary.
examples.zh: 我们把「实际汇率制度」和年度综述中正式说明的制度作了比较。

collocations: classify a de facto exchange rate regime
identify the de facto exchange rate regime
compare the de facto regime with the official arrangement

words.enDefinition: the exchange rate arrangement formally announced or reported by the authorities

examples.en: The table listed the de jure exchange rate regime using the country's official statement for the period.
examples.zh: 表格依照该国本期官方声明，列出「官方公布的汇率制度」。

examples.en: The tutor explained that the de jure exchange rate regime could differ from patterns visible in the data.
examples.zh: 导师说明，「官方公布的汇率制度」可能与数据中可见的实际走势不一致。

collocations: report a de jure exchange rate regime
identify the de jure exchange rate regime
compare de jure and observed exchange arrangements

words.enDefinition: a rise in the value of a currency relative to another currency or a basket of currencies

examples.en: We observed exchange rate appreciation when the local currency bought more units of the foreign currency than before.
examples.zh: 当本币能买到更多单位的外币时，我们观察到「货币升值」。

examples.en: The tutor checked the quote convention before calling the currency's move exchange rate appreciation in the example.
examples.zh: 导师先核对报价口径，再把示例中的货币变动称为「货币升值」。

collocations: compare the effects of exchange rate appreciation

words.enDefinition: a fall in the value of a currency relative to another currency or a basket

examples.en: In the example, exchange rate depreciation meant that the local currency bought fewer units of the foreign currency.
examples.zh: 在示例中，「货币贬值」意味着本币可以兑换的外币单位变少。

examples.en: We discussed how exchange rate depreciation affected the local cost of imported inputs in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们讨论「货币贬值」如何影响课堂模型中进口投入要素的本币成本。

collocations: study the effects of exchange rate depreciation

words.enDefinition: an official reduction in a currency's fixed or targeted value against its anchor

examples.en: The historical example showed a currency devaluation announced under an arrangement with an official parity.
examples.zh: 历史示例展示了有官方平价的安排下公布的「官方下调本币平价」。

examples.en: The class compared the announced currency devaluation with an earlier decline under a floating exchange regime.
examples.zh: 同学们把公布的「官方下调本币平价」与更早在浮动汇率制度下出现的跌势作了比较。

collocations: analyse the effects of currency devaluation
compare a currency devaluation with depreciation

words.enDefinition: an official increase in a currency's fixed or targeted value against its anchor

examples.en: The model's currency revaluation raised the official value of the local currency against the one it followed.
examples.zh: 模型中的「官方上调本币平价」提高了本币相对所盯住货币的官方价值。

examples.en: Our tutor used currency revaluation to distinguish a change in the official parity from ordinary daily trading movements.
examples.zh: 导师用「官方上调本币平价」区分官方平价变化与日常交易波动。

collocations: study the effects of currency revaluation

words.enDefinition: an exchange rate between two currencies adjusted for relative price levels in the two economies

examples.en: The real bilateral exchange rate took account of the higher domestic prices shown for the second year.
examples.zh: 「实际双边汇率」计入了第二年所列国内价格较高的因素。

examples.en: Our class calculated the real bilateral exchange rate after aligning the price measures and the currency quote convention.
examples.zh: 同学们统一价格指标和货币报价口径后，计算了「实际双边汇率」。

collocations: calculate a real bilateral exchange rate
interpret movements in the real bilateral exchange rate

words.enDefinition: an index combining exchange rates against multiple partners' currencies using specified weights without relative price adjustment

examples.en: The nominal effective exchange rate reflected movements against several currencies instead of the rate against just one partner.
examples.zh: 「名义有效汇率」反映相对多种货币的变动，涵盖的范围超过单一伙伴的汇率。

examples.en: We read the weighting note before comparing the nominal effective exchange rate indexes published for two economies.
examples.zh: 比较两个经济体公布的「名义有效汇率」指数前，我们先看了权重说明。

collocations: calculate a nominal effective exchange rate
report the nominal effective exchange rate
compare changes in nominal effective exchange rates

words.enDefinition: an index of a currency against multiple partner currencies adjusted for relative prices or costs under stated weights

examples.en: We compared the real effective exchange rate with its nominal counterpart after domestic prices outpaced partner prices.
examples.zh: 国内价格上涨速度超过贸易伙伴后，我们把「实际有效汇率」与其名义指标作了比较。

examples.en: The report described which price index it used to calculate the real effective exchange rate in the table.
examples.zh: 报告说明它用哪个价格指数计算表中的「实际有效汇率」。

collocations: calculate a real effective exchange rate
report the real effective exchange rate
compare changes in real effective exchange rates

words.enDefinition: the extent to which changes in exchange rates are reflected in import, producer or consumer prices

examples.en: The estimated exchange rate pass-through was incomplete because import prices moved by less than the currency did.
examples.zh: 进口价格变动幅度小于货币变动幅度，因此估计的「汇率传导」不完全。

examples.en: We compared exchange rate pass-through to border prices with the response of prices at local shops.
examples.zh: 我们比较了边境价格的「汇率传导」和当地商店价格的反应。

collocations: measure exchange rate pass-through to import prices
compare exchange rate pass-through across products

words.enDefinition: a pattern in which the trade balance initially worsens after depreciation before improving as quantities adjust

examples.en: The tutor illustrated the J-curve effect with a model where import prices changed before quantities could respond.
examples.zh: 导师用一个进口价格先变、数量随后作出反应的模型演示了「J 曲线效应」。

examples.en: The report tested for a J-curve effect by comparing trade balances across several quarters after the currency moved.
examples.zh: 报告比较汇率变动后几个季度的贸易差额，以检验是否存在「J 曲线效应」。

collocations: explain the timing of the J-curve effect

words.enDefinition: in a standard initially balanced trade model, depreciation improves the trade balance if the absolute import and export demand elasticities sum to more than one

examples.en: The tutor used the Marshall-Lerner condition to explain why responsiveness of both import and export quantities mattered.
examples.zh: 导师用「马歇尔勒纳条件」说明，进口和出口数量的响应程度为何都重要。

examples.en: We checked the assumptions behind the Marshall-Lerner condition before interpreting the two elasticities in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 解读练习表里的两个弹性之前，我们核查了「马歇尔勒纳条件」所依赖的假设。

collocations: state the assumptions of the Marshall-Lerner condition

words.enDefinition: the study of economic transformation, living conditions and policy challenges during development

examples.en: The development economics course compared improvements in household living conditions with changes in national income over time.
examples.zh: 「发展经济学」课程比较家庭生活条件的改善与国民收入随时间发生的变化。

examples.en: We used development economics readings to discuss why some rural households had difficulty accessing formal jobs.
examples.zh: 我们用「发展经济学」阅读资料讨论为何有些农村家庭难以进入正规就业岗位。

collocations: read a study in development economics

words.enDefinition: gross national income divided by population, under the population and currency conventions used by the statistical source

examples.en: We compared gross national income per capita after confirming both columns used the same conversion method.
examples.zh: 确认两列数据使用相同换算方法后，我们比较了「人均国民总收入」。

examples.en: The class discussed why gross national income per capita could rise without every household receiving more income.
examples.zh: 同学们讨论了为何即使并非每户都增收，「人均国民总收入」也可能上升。

collocations: calculate gross national income per capita
compare gross national income per capita
report gross national income per capita

words.zhGloss: 按购买力平价计的人均国民总收入
words.enDefinition: gross national income per person expressed in common purchasing-power units using a purchasing power parity conversion
acceptedZhAnswers: 按购买力平价计的人均国民总收入

examples.en: The report used GNI per capita at PPP to compare average incomes across economies with different price levels.
examples.zh: 报告用「按购买力平价计的人均国民总收入」比较价格水平不同的经济体的平均收入。

examples.en: We checked whether the column measured GNI per capita at PPP or used a market exchange rate.
examples.zh: 我们核查该列衡量的是「按购买力平价计的人均国民总收入」，还是按市场汇率换算的数字。

collocations: compare GNI per capita at PPP
report GNI per capita at PPP
express GNI per capita at PPP

words.enDefinition: the domestic currency units needed to purchase the equivalent of one common purchasing-power unit for a specified aggregate

examples.en: The table listed the purchasing power parity conversion factor beside the exchange rate for the same reference year.
examples.zh: 表中将「购买力平价换算因子」与同一参考年度的汇率并排列出。

examples.en: We used the purchasing power parity conversion factor to compare the purchasing power of the example incomes.
examples.zh: 我们用「购买力平价换算因子」比较示例收入的购买力。

collocations: apply a purchasing power parity conversion factor
compare purchasing power parity conversion factors
check the reference year of a purchasing power parity conversion factor

words.enDefinition: a reference year for which purchasing power parities are estimated directly through a comparison programme rather than extrapolated

examples.en: The note identified the PPP benchmark year underlying the later estimates extrapolated with other price measures.
examples.zh: 附注列出了「购买力平价基准年」，后续数据由这个基准和其他价格指标推算得出。

examples.en: We kept the PPP benchmark year consistent when comparing the source's two estimates of real household spending.
examples.zh: 比较同一来源对实际家庭支出的两项估计时，我们采用相同的「购买力平价基准年」。

collocations: compare figures from the same PPP benchmark year

words.enDefinition: a coordinated statistical programme comparing price levels and estimating purchasing power parities across economies

examples.en: We read an International Comparison Program summary before comparing prices in the two countries for similar goods.
examples.zh: 比较两个国家类似商品的价格之前，我们读了「国际比较项目」的概述。

examples.en: The report credited the International Comparison Program for the benchmark estimates underlying its comparison of real expenditure.
examples.zh: 报告说明实际支出比较所依据的基准估计来自「国际比较项目」。

words.enDefinition: a common purchasing-power unit with purchasing power equivalent to a US dollar in the United States for the stated comparison

examples.en: The table used the international dollar so comparable incomes could be displayed in a common purchasing-power unit.
examples.zh: 表格使用「国际元」，让可比收入能用一种共同购买力单位列出。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished an international dollar from a US dollar received in an actual currency exchange.
examples.zh: 导师区分了「国际元」与实际货币兑换中收到的一美元。

collocations: report an amount in international dollars
an international dollar at purchasing power parity

words.enDefinition: an index comparing price levels across economies by relating purchasing power parity to the corresponding market exchange rate

examples.en: The price level index showed which economy had higher overall prices relative to the common reference point.
examples.zh: 「跨国价格水平指数」显示相对于共同参考点，哪个经济体的总体价格更高。

examples.en: We checked the reference economy before comparing two published values of the price level index for consumption.
examples.zh: 比较两项公布的消费「跨国价格水平指数」前，我们核对了参考经济体。

collocations: choose a reference for a price level index

words.enDefinition: a poverty threshold defined for a particular country according to its own measurement criteria

examples.en: The survey measured the share of households below the national poverty line specified in the accompanying notes.
examples.zh: 调查统计低于附注所指定「国家贫困线」的家庭占比。

examples.en: We checked how the national poverty line was adjusted for local living costs in the example report.
examples.zh: 我们核查了示例报告如何按当地生活成本调整「国家贫困线」。

collocations: measure poverty at the national poverty line

words.enDefinition: a threshold in common purchasing-power units used to compare poverty across countries

examples.en: The study used an international poverty line rather than comparing two national thresholds quoted in different currencies.
examples.zh: 研究使用「国际贫困线」开展比较，避免直接使用以不同货币表示的两条国家贫困线。

examples.en: Our tutor checked the reference purchasing power parity year attached to the international poverty line in the dataset.
examples.zh: 导师核对了数据集中「国际贫困线」对应的购买力平价基准年度。

collocations: measure poverty at the international poverty line

words.enDefinition: the share of the relevant population living below a specified income or consumption poverty threshold

examples.en: The poverty headcount ratio fell after several households moved slightly above the threshold in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中几户家庭刚刚越过贫困线，「贫困人口比率」随之下降。

examples.en: We compared the poverty headcount ratio using two thresholds and reported how the results differed.
examples.zh: 我们用两条贫困线计算「贫困人口比率」，并报告结果的差异。

words.enDefinition: the average shortfall below the poverty threshold across the population as a share of the line, counting zero for everyone at or above it

examples.en: The poverty gap index rose when households already below the threshold moved farther below it in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，原本就在贫困线下的家庭离贫困线更远时，「贫困差距指数」上升了。

examples.en: We compared the poverty gap index for two regions with the same number of people below the line.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个贫困线下人数相同地区的「贫困差距指数」。

collocations: interpret a change in the poverty gap index

words.enDefinition: poverty measured relative to the standard of living or income distribution in the same society

examples.en: The model defined relative poverty using a threshold set as a share of the national median income.
examples.zh: 模型用相当于全国收入中位数一定比例的门槛定义「相对贫困」。

examples.en: We compared relative poverty in two periods after checking how the threshold changed when median income increased.
examples.zh: 我们检查收入中位数提高时门槛怎样变化，再比较两个时期的「相对贫困」。

words.enDefinition: poverty measured against a minimum standard of resources or basic needs held constant in real terms for the comparison

examples.en: The exercise discussed absolute poverty using a fixed purchasing-power threshold across both model years.
examples.zh: 练习使用在两个模型年度保持固定购买力的门槛讨论「绝对贫困」。

examples.en: We checked how the cost of basic needs was reflected in the study's measure of absolute poverty.
examples.zh: 我们查看研究所用的「绝对贫困」指标怎样体现基本生活所需的成本。

words.enDefinition: a poverty indicator combining deprivations across several domains such as health, education and living conditions

examples.en: The multidimensional poverty measure recorded some households as deprived because they lacked access to several essential services.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏多项基本服务，「多维贫困指标」将部分家庭记录为面临匮乏。

examples.en: We compared the multidimensional poverty measure with the income-based rate for the same communities in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上将「多维贫困指标」与同一批社区按收入测算的比率作了比较。

words.enDefinition: shortfalls experienced across several dimensions of wellbeing or basic living conditions

examples.en: The table showed overlapping indicators of multidimensional deprivation in schooling and access to safe water.
examples.zh: 该表显示了教育与安全用水方面相互重叠的「多维匮乏」指标。

examples.en: We discussed multidimensional deprivation after noticing that similar incomes coexisted with very different levels of service access.
examples.zh: 发现收入相近的群体享受服务的水平却非常不同后，我们讨论了「多维匮乏」。

words.enDefinition: a UNDP composite index combining standardised measures of health, education and income through a geometric mean

examples.en: The Human Development Index differed across two economies that reported comparable average incomes in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例里，两个报告平均收入相近的经济体具有不同的「人类发展指数」。

examples.en: We checked which education indicators entered the Human Development Index before discussing why one country's score changed.
examples.zh: 讨论某国得分为何变化之前，我们核查「人类发展指数」纳入哪些教育指标。

words.zhGloss: 不平等调整后的人类发展指数
words.enDefinition: a UNDP measure discounting each human development dimension to account for inequality within the population
acceptedZhAnswers: 不平等调整后的人类发展指数

examples.en: We compared the Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index with the unadjusted measure to see the effect of uneven outcomes.
examples.zh: 我们把「不平等调整后的人类发展指数」与未调整指标比较，了解结果分布不均的影响。

examples.en: The lesson used the Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index to discuss unequal health and education outcomes.
examples.zh: 课程用「不平等调整后的人类发展指数」讨论健康和教育结果的不平等。

collocations: report the Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index
compare Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index values
calculate the loss implied by the Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index

words.enDefinition: long-run reallocation of activity and workers across sectors of an economy as it develops

examples.en: The report traced structural transformation as employment shifted from agriculture toward manufacturing and services over several decades.
examples.zh: 报告跟踪了「结构转型」，期间就业在几十年里从农业转向制造业和服务业。

examples.en: We compared structural transformation across regions where new industries absorbed very different shares of the workforce.
examples.zh: 我们比较不同地区的「结构转型」，这些地区新行业吸收的劳动力比例差别很大。

collocations: study a period of structural transformation

words.enDefinition: the fraction of total employment accounted for by a specified sector

examples.en: The sectoral employment share of manufacturing rose even though employment in agriculture also increased in absolute terms.
examples.zh: 尽管农业就业人数绝对值也增加，制造业的「部门就业占比」仍然上升。

examples.en: We tracked each sectoral employment share before explaining how the composition of work had changed over time.
examples.zh: 解释工作构成怎样随时间变化前，我们跟踪了各「部门就业占比」。

collocations: report changes in sectoral employment shares

words.enDefinition: movement of people from rural areas to urban areas to live, work or pursue other opportunities

examples.en: The study tracked rural-urban migration after new jobs became available in the nearby town in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中附近城镇出现新岗位后，研究跟踪了「农村向城市迁移」。

examples.en: We compared rural-urban migration with daily commuting when discussing how the survey counted permanent moves.
examples.zh: 讨论调查怎样统计永久性搬迁时，我们把「农村向城市迁移」和日常通勤作了比较。

words.enDefinition: employment without specified formal arrangements or protections, as defined by the applicable labour statistics standard

examples.en: The report measured informal employment after documenting which categories were covered by its household survey.
examples.zh: 报告说明住户调查涵盖哪些类别后，对「非正规就业」作了统计。

examples.en: We checked how informal employment was defined before comparing the two estimates in the dataset.
examples.zh: 比较数据集内的两个估计值之前，我们核查了「非正规就业」的定义。

collocations: estimate the share of informal employment

words.enDefinition: broadening the industries or activities from which an economy obtains production, employment or income

examples.en: The policy example tracked economic diversification as several new manufacturing and service sectors began to grow.
examples.zh: 几个新的制造和服务行业开始增长时，政策示例跟踪了「经济多元化」。

examples.en: We discussed economic diversification after finding that the region still relied on one main source of revenue.
examples.zh: 发现该地区仍依赖一个主要收入来源后，我们讨论了「经济多元化」。

words.enDefinition: a proposed pattern in which economies reaching middle-income levels struggle to sustain progress toward high-income levels

examples.en: The course discussed the middle-income trap while noting that researchers use different thresholds and periods to define it.
examples.zh: 课程讨论了「中等收入陷阱」，同时指出研究人员用不同门槛和时段界定它。

examples.en: We compared proposed explanations for the middle-income trap after reading about changing productivity in several industries.
examples.zh: 阅读数个行业生产率变化的资料后，我们比较了「中等收入陷阱」的几种解释。

collocations: compare explanations for the middle-income trap

words.enDefinition: official support for economic development and welfare that meets OECD DAC eligibility and concessionality criteria

examples.en: The report separated official development assistance from commercial financing for the sample infrastructure projects.
examples.zh: 报告将「官方发展援助」与示例基础设施项目的商业融资分开列示。

examples.en: We checked whether official development assistance was reported as flows or using the grant equivalent measure.
examples.zh: 我们核查「官方发展援助」采用资金流量还是赠款等值口径列报。

collocations: compare official development assistance across years

words.enDefinition: a public programme payment to eligible households conditional on specified actions or requirements

examples.en: The example conditional cash transfer linked payment to a requirement that the programme had defined in advance.
examples.zh: 示例中的「有条件现金转移」将付款与项目事先明确的一项要求挂钩。

examples.en: We compared participation under a conditional cash transfer with participation in the hypothetical programme without that condition.
examples.zh: 我们比较「有条件现金转移」与没有该条件的假想项目的参与情况。

collocations: compare a conditional cash transfer with an unconditional payment

words.enDefinition: a programme payment to eligible recipients without imposing a behavioural requirement as a condition of payment

examples.en: The class evaluated an unconditional cash transfer that had eligibility rules but imposed no behavioural conditions.
examples.zh: 课堂评估了一项设有资格规则、但无行为条件的「无条件现金转移」。

examples.en: We checked how the unconditional cash transfer affected household survey responses in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 我们检查了假想示例中「无条件现金转移」如何影响家庭问卷答复。

collocations: compare unconditional cash transfers with conditional programmes

words.enDefinition: a mismatch between who actually receives a programme and who is intended to receive it

examples.en: The evaluation measured targeting error after comparing the beneficiary list with the programme's stated eligibility rules.
examples.zh: 评估将受益者名单与项目公示的资格规则比较后，衡量了「救助对象识别偏差」。

examples.en: We discussed how incomplete survey coverage might contribute to targeting error in the experimental programme.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了调查覆盖不全为何可能导致实验项目出现「救助对象识别偏差」。

words.enDefinition: the receipt of a targeted benefit by someone outside the intended eligible group

examples.en: The classroom example counted an inclusion error when a payment went to an ineligible household in the sample.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中，补助付给样本中不符合资格的家庭时，记作一次「错纳误差」。

examples.en: We reported the inclusion error rate using all recipients as the denominator in the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 课堂比较以所有领取者为分母，我们据此报告「错纳误差」的发生率。

collocations: estimate the rate of inclusion error
distinguish inclusion error from exclusion error

words.enDefinition: failure of a targeted programme to reach someone in its intended eligible group

examples.en: An exclusion error appeared when a household meeting the sample rules was absent from the list of recipients.
examples.zh: 符合示例规则的一户家庭未出现在领取名单上，因此出现一项「漏纳误差」。

examples.en: We estimated the exclusion error rate by dividing eligible nonrecipients by the total number of eligible households.
examples.zh: 我们用未领取款项的合资格家庭数除以合资格家庭总数，估算「漏纳误差」的发生率。

collocations: compare inclusion error and exclusion error
